subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for real-time routing — Nimbus Logistics
messages:
From: Maria Chen <maria.chen@nimbuslogistics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for real-time routing — Nimbus Logistics

Hi Dylan / Neha,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and had a good look at the hosted API, but for our production rollout we need to evaluate Redwood Dedicated. Our primary concerns are throughput and predictable p95 latency for a real-time routing use case. High level numbers:~

- Peak steady QPS: ~350–450 requests/s (spiky traffic during reroute windows)
- Typical request size: ~400–700 tokens round trip
- Target p95 latency: <120 ms (token generation end-to-end)
- KV cache per request: small (4–8 context entries)

We'd like a focused demo of Dedicated capacity with an emphasis on latency SLOs and autoscale behavior under short bursts. Can you propose a couple of slots next week? We are PT-based (West Coast). Also attaching a short workload summary.

Attachments: nimbus_workload_summary.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Maria Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Logistics
ops@nimbuslogistics.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Maria Chen <maria.chen@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 19:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for real-time routing — Nimbus Logistics

Hi Maria — great to meet you and thanks for the details.

We can absolutely walk through Dedicated and focus on throughput/latency. Quick items before the call so we tailor the demo:

- Can you confirm typical and peak sequence length distributions and percentiles? (you did a nice summary but the percentiles help our kernel selection)
- Do you store any long-term KV cache per user?
- Any compliance questions up front (SOC2, data residency)?

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 10/20 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 10/21 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 10/22 09:00–09:45 PT (backup)

If none work, tell us a 2-hour window and we'll find a match. I'm attaching a short capacity template that helps us pre-run a mini-benchmark against a compatible model. Please fill the second tab with example payloads if you can.

Attachments: capacity_template.xlsx

Thanks — I can lead the product portion and Neha (cc'd) will coordinate contract/next steps. For a deeper latency-benchmarking conversation we'll bring Stephanie Nguyen (solutions engineer) to the call if that works for you.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
SDR, Redwood Inference
+dylan@redwood.com

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the quick follow. Wed 10/21 14:00 PT works for our team, but heads up: our CTO may need to drop into the last 10–15 minutes and there's a chance we need to push by an hour.

A few clarifications: we do short-lived per-session KV (max 20 keys), and 99th token length is around 650 tokens. We'll upload a filled version of the capacity template by EOD PT.

Also, we're collecting vendor benchmark artifacts for our procurement packet — sample CSV with request/response times and a one-page summary would be helpful to include. Can Redwood provide short benchmark results for a comparable model/instance type?

Thanks — Maria
